question: What defining characteristic relates the supreme truth and liberation to the gross and subtle?
premises: Supreme truth and liberation are named together.
The gross and subtle are presented as a domain to be characterized.
A characteristic of that domain is indicated.
inference: The supreme truth and liberation are presented as the characteristic of the gross and subtle.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation is compressed and may depend on the surrounding verses.
plain_english: And the supreme truth and liberation are the characteristic of the gross and the subtle.
